claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin::on_caster
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Spirit Guardians creates a 15-foot Emanation centered on the caster that moves with the caster each turn. The existing AreaOrigin variants (point_within_range, on_primary_target) cannot express a caster-following area. point_within_range is a static point; on_primary_target attaches to a target creature. Neither covers 'attached to the caster's position and moves with them.'
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Protective spirits flit around you in a 15-foot Emanation for the duration."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation::area_save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's core damage mechanic fires via a Wisdom saving throw triggered by entering the emanation or ending a turn there, dealing 3d8 on fail and half on success. The existing OngoingOperation variants are roll_modifier (modifies attack/save rolls) and damage_on_hit (caster attack-roll rider). Neither models 'save gate triggered by area entry / turn-end, with half-damage on success.' This is a structurally distinct ongoing operation pattern.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "whenever the Emanation enters a creature's space and whenever a creature enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, the creature must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 Radiant damage... On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation::modify_speed
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell persistently halves the Speed of any non-exempt creature while in the emanation. The v4 atom modify_speed exists in the taxonomy but there is no OngoingOperation variant to express persistent speed modification on an area attachment. This is mechanically distinct from roll_modifier and damage_on_hit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Any other creature's Speed is halved in the Emanation"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DamageEffect: conditional damage type by caster state
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage type is Radiant if the caster is good or neutral, Necrotic if the caster is evil. DamageEffect currently takes a single fixed DamageType. A conditional-type expression keyed on caster character state (alignment) is not representable. This is a secondary gap; the primary gaps above prevent encoding regardless.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "the creature takes 3d8 Radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 Necrotic damage (if you are evil)"
